text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, I lost.
I was so close, too."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. This isn't bad either.
I know it's not a bad result at all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... I heard them.
Everyone's voices cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a lie, right?
But it's totally true!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Usually, all I can hear is the beating of my heart, my own breathing, and the sound of the wind, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today... I clearly heard a voice.
It was shouting, "Go for it, Nei-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It felt like someone was giving me a push from behind...
and running was so, so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I really wanted to answer them.
All those cheers, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—In this race, where their voices could reach me.
I really wanted to win properly, you know?

For Nice Nature, who shares a deep bond with those who support her,
this Arima Kinen seems to have become a truly special race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to reward everyone's support.
Next year... I want to get my revenge.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, you dummy!Isn't it way too early for that!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Because cheering for you really did feel great... *mumble*

Targeting next year's Arima Kinen from this early on
might indeed be setting the goal a bit too far ahead.

If we were to slot in a race in between
to maintain this current motivation...
choice_data_list: We've got the Takarazuka Kinen coming up too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen... That's the race where contenders are chosen by fan vote, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Just like the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turning cheers into strength... I never thought
I'd be the one saying something like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I really want to make it count.
Yeah... I want to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!"

"Even so, that goal is still a bit further down the line.
We decided to grow toward the Takarazuka Kinen while running various other races along the way."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now then... before that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "I really need to look back and reflect on what I did wrong..."

Nice Nature murmured, her eyes drifting toward
the fellow Umamusume who had run the Arima Kinen
with her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...The 'wobbly trophy.'
Did you prepare one for me today too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Thank you.
Well then... debrief first, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"—Looking back at how I used to be...
Honestly, I wasn't really paying attention to what was around me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on the gap between me and Teio
that I forgot there are other rivals out there too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Running out there today really hammered it home.
It goes without saying, but everyone was on an extraordinarily high level.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't even win definitively right now.
Moving forward, everyone around me is just going to keep getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I can't go on like this.
This is no time to be talking about beating Teio."

For better or worse, Nice Nature had spent all this time
watching nothing but Tokai Teio,
who ran far ahead at the front of their generation.

However, running in the Arima Kinen alongside
many different generations seems to have broadened your horizons.
...A true sign of growth!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I need to know.
More about everyone around me...!

—On the way home.
That opportunity arrived sooner than expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Come join me for a post-race debrief after this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Well then, let us find a place—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No need for that!
Let's head back and talk while doing muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Right now!?
Th-That's a bit...!

Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.
Though they had competed against Nice Nature today, they appeared so calm you wouldn't think they had just finished a race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Those two...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait here for a moment, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for earlier.
I have firmly taken note of your strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you were super strong!
Great work to both of us!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, there's something I wanted to ask you two!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering...
how both of you... can stay so strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...You might think it's not like me to ask something like this, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, those two, how should I put it... feel like they truly stand on their own two feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what an interesting thing to say.
On your own two feet... huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do, McQueen?
You're much better at this sort of thing than me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Honestly, there you go again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then.
If you truly wish to know, I shall enlighten you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention
of explaining every single little detail to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you something far more certain than mere words.
I am sure that will be more than enough for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Come hang out anytime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what you want,
I'm more than ready to whip you into shape!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan's training is
truly grueling, so please prepare yourself."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell.
—Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen!
For our review meeting, the gym is fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That idea is rejected!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Something certain...?
What does that mean...

—Leaving a strong anticipation of newfound growth,
her Classic Year challenge came to a close.
